title: Manchester United vs Liverpool — last 5 head-to-head moments
body: Last 5 competitive Manchester United vs Liverpool fixtures, ordered chronologically (oldest = #5, most recent = #1). Each fixture's most-replayed moment becomes one rank in the rivalry recap, with a real broadcast cut-in pinned to its rank phrase.

rivalry.verification: literal last-5 — verified against ESPN / Premier League / manutd.com / liverpoolfc.com fixture pages on 2026-05-04. Helper-output's Wikipedia-summary fixtures (which only went up to the 2023-03-05 7-0) replaced with the actual last-5 competitive meetings.

fixtures.key_moment: Bruno Fernandes halfway-line strike + Kobbie Mainoo's 67' rocket at age 18; Mohamed Salah's 81' penalty equaliser denied United victory.
fixtures.broadcast_research_query: Manchester United vs Liverpool 7 April 2024 highlights official

fixtures.key_moment: Luis Diaz first-half brace (35', 42') + Salah second-half; Arne Slot the first Liverpool manager since Bob Paisley (1975) to win his first United meeting.
fixtures.broadcast_research_query: Manchester United vs Liverpool September 2024 highlights official

fixtures.key_moment: Amad Diallo's 80th-minute equaliser denies Premier League leaders; Amorim's first big point at United (Martinez 52', Gakpo 59', Salah pen 70', Amad 80').
fixtures.broadcast_research_query: Liverpool vs Manchester United January 2025 highlights official

fixtures.key_moment: Bryan Mbeumo opener inside 2 minutes + Harry Maguire 84' header; first United win at Anfield in nine years (since 2016).
fixtures.broadcast_research_query: Liverpool vs Manchester United October 2025 highlights official

fixtures.key_moment: Cunha 6' + Sesko 14'; Liverpool clawed back through Szoboszlai 47' + Gakpo 56'; Kobbie Mainoo 77th-minute winner sealed first PL double over Liverpool in a decade and Champions League qualification.
